label: X4: Foundations sandboxes
description: How X4: Foundations sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: Extensions are switched on in the game's Extensions menu; the folder being present only makes them available.
Settings and saves are in Documents/Egosoft/X4.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.

presets.label: Clean
presets.description: Nothing deployed - the vanilla game, for checking whether a bug is yours.

options.label: Additional launch arguments
options.description: Passed verbatim. One argument per space; nothing here goes through a shell.
